units.title: Introduction to Operational Amplifiers
topics: 1.1. Linear Integrated circuits: classification, packages, pin identification, temperature range and other parameters.
1.2. Amplifier: transistor differential pair, differential amplifier with constant current bias.
1.3. Operational amplifier: definition, block diagram, schematic symbol, current mirror concept
uos: 1.a. Identify various types of ICs and packages.
1.b. Explain the working of differential amplifier
1.c. Describe the block diagram of Op-amplifier.

units.title: Performance of Op-Amps
topics: 2.1. Opamp Parameters: input offset voltage, and current, input bias current, differential input resistance, input capacitance, offset voltage adjustment range, input voltage range, common mode rejection ratio, supply voltage rejection ratio, large signal voltage gain, output voltage swing, output resistance, output short circuit current, supply current, power consumption, transient response, slew rate, gain bandwidth product, average temperature coefficient of input offset voltage and current, noise
2.2. Opamp: Characteristics of ideal op-amp, equivalent circuit, virtual ground.
2.3. Open loop configuration: inverting, non- inverting opamps
uos: 2.a. Define the parameters of OP- AMPS.
2.b. Describe the characteristics of ideal opamps.
2.c. Explain the working of inverting and non-inverting types of opamps configurations.
2.d. State the steps to test the performance of opamps

units.title: Op-Amp with Negative Feedback
topics: 3.1. Voltage series feedback: negative feedback, closed loop voltage gain, difference input voltage
3.2. Voltage shunt feedback: closed loop voltage gain, inverting input terminal at virtual ground, current to voltage converter, inverter
3.3. Differential amplifier: with one opamp, two opamps
uos: 3.a. Explain working of voltage series feedback amplifier.
3.b. Explain working of voltage shunt feedback amplifier.
3.c. Explain the working of differential amplifiers.

units.title: Linear Applications
topics: 4.1. Amplifier: AC, DC, AC amplifier with single supply
uos: 4.a. Differentiate between AC and DC amplifier
4.b. Distinguish the working of Summing, Scaling and Averaging amplifier

4.c. Discriminate the working of 4.3. Voltage to current converter with Linear Electronic Circuits Course code: 3332405 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/12-13 Gujarat State 3 Unit Major Learning Outcomes (‘Course Outcomes’ in Cognitive Domain according to NBA terminology) Topics and Sub-topics voltage to current converter, Integrator, Differentiator and instrumentation circuits. grounded load, Integrator, differentiator, instrumentation amplifier.

units.title: Comparators and Converters
topics: 5.1. Comparator: characteristics, basic comparator, Zero crossing detector, Schmitt trigger and limitations.
5.2. Digital to analog converter: binary weighted, R- 2R
5.3. Analog to digital converter: successive approximation, continuous type.
uos: 5.a. Select the relevant comparators for any given linear circuit
5.b. Explain the working of Digital to Analog converter
5.c. Describe the working of Analog to Digital converter
